description: Get reference documentation for the Orderly Public Info API — a zero-auth single endpoint (POST /v1/public/query) for market, account, and platform data selected by a `type` field. Covers 24 query types (marketSummary, accountState, orderbook, candles, topAddresses, whaleContext, etc.); `queryType` accepts exact, partial, or fuzzy names and returns params, response fields, example, weight, and freshness; `category` lists a group (queryType wins if both are supplied); omit both for the overview and rate-limit rules. Read-only bundled docs — it does not call the endpoint. Use instead of get_api_info for zero-auth public data; use get_api_info for authenticated trading, get_indexer_api_info for historical analytics, and get_strategy_vault_api_info for vault data.

category.description: Browse a category instead: "market", "account", "platform", or "system". Use instead of queryType to list all types in a category.

queryType.description: Query type name (e.g., "marketSummary", "accountState", "orderbook", "candles", "topAddresses", "whaleContext"). Returns full details: params, response fields, example, weight, freshness.

name: get_public_info_api_info
